recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not restore core `communication-request` message event codes unless a future InM/PC decision re-standardizes core FHIR message event codes; CommunicationRequest-based messages can use implementation-defined or IG-defined event codes under the current model.
issue_request: FHIR-8048 was Published/Persuasive and asked to add `communication-request` as a generated MessageEvents code for CommunicationRequest messages whose root conveyed a request to tell someone information.
initial_application: The request was applied by commit 9f82d098055987a7913dff68e7a1dcd0ae199932, which edited source/communicationrequest/communicationrequest-spreadsheet.xml so the `communication-request` row had Notification semantics and CommunicationRequest focus. That spreadsheet source was removed during the 2021 new-build-core migration.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini actively includes CommunicationRequest, MessageHeader, and MessageDefinition. Later Published issue FHIR-26902 intentionally removed the empty core MessageEvent value set/code system, made message event bindings example/descriptive, and established that FHIR does not define message event codes; the combined branch already contains the FHIR-26902 source-fix commit.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing `communication-request` as a core event code would conflict with the current MessageEvent binding model, and current source has no active core MessageEvent URL or stale `communication-request` event row requiring a fix.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive-with-Modification issue removed core MessageEvent code-system/value-set references and established the current policy that FHIR does not define message event codes.
